title: code/* branch pipelines run the gate jobs without a click
goal: In .gitlab-ci.yml the jobs the ci-code-branch gate of ST-vcf3r6qv “sync --push sends code-lane work as a merge request” names run without a click in pipelines of code/* branches (a first rule on $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH =~ /^code\//), and every other job and branch keeps its rules; TestCiCodeBranch in _tools/test_ci_config.py reads the file as text and asserts it; git.md says what runs where
notes: The test reads the YAML as text: no new dependency. kb-trailers' rule ($CI_PIPELINE_SOURCE == "push" && $CI_COMMIT_BRANCH) matches a code/* push. .github/workflows/kb.yml runs every job on every pushed branch already, so it needs no change.
